items.title: Micron’s AI boom rolls on with $10 billion Iowa data center

items.title: Sandisk (SNDK) Was Hit By A Hedge Fund Liquidation After A $35 Billion Loss
items.summary: Hedge fund with large positions in Sandisk (NasdaqGS:SNDK) and Micron was forced into distressed liquidation after both stocks collapsed in July. Forced selling removed a major institutional holder from Sandisk, with reported losses of about US$35b and a sharp reduction in fund size. The event highlights concentration risk in volatile memory and AI infrastructure stocks and raises questions about fund risk controls. items.title: Why Is Micron Technology (MU) Spending $10 Billion On A New AI Research Hub?
items.summary: Micron Technology (NasdaqGS:MU) announced a US$10b investment over the next decade to create Micron Research Labs, a new U.S. research hub for next generation memory and semiconductor technologies. The Micron Research Labs initiative is focused on AI era memory and compute architectures, with plans to work alongside industry partners, universities, and U.S. government agencies. items.title: Michael Burry Says the AI Buildout Is Repeating 2008: ‘The Shenanigans Are Apparent Today’
items.summary: The investor who called 2008 before anyone else is now naming specific AI infrastructure companies and the hidden financial mechanisms he says are quietly building the next crisis. His latest warning may be easy to dismiss, but his receipts are hard to ignore.
